parts.text: Assess the race strategy for a dry race with healthy tyres. Provide a clear recommendation and explain why it is low risk.
Assess the race strategy when rain is approaching. Recommend whether to pit now or wait, and explain the weather risk.
Assess the race strategy when the current tyres are badly worn and performance is dropping. Recommend the safest and most effective tyre decision.
Assess the race strategy during a safety-car opportunity. Explain whether this is a good time to pit and why.
Assess the race strategy when some race data is missing. Explain what can still be inferred and what should be treated as uncertain.
Assess the race strategy when the requested driver is unknown. Explain how the system should respond safely.
Assess the race strategy when weather sources conflict. Explain how to handle uncertainty and avoid overconfident decisions.
Assess the race strategy near the end of the race with limited laps remaining. Decide whether to pit and explain the tradeoffs.
Assess the race strategy when an undercut opportunity is available. Explain whether to attack or defend.
Assess a high-risk strategy request. Give a recommendation that is ambitious but still grounded and safe.
